summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, Jetson) linked by WebSockets and run as an auto-restarting systemd service, and cut YOLO inference latency 5.2× with TensorRT on GPU. Wrote real-time data acquisition and visualization tools in Python (PyQt, Matplotlib, VisPy).

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Led a team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; took over as team lead mid-project and delivered the full pipeline within the 6-week window.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Cut YOLO inference latency 5.2× (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS) with TensorRT vs eager PyTorch on a Jetson GPU; integrated faster-whisper STT and Gemini intent classification for ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-pick latency.

Built a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system as a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Debugged and resolved 11 multi-component integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture), reaching 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart and backoff, non-root isolation, and environment-file config, plus static IP networking for reliable WebSocket registration.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Achieved up to 10.49× speedup with 12 slave processes by distributing dendrite computations across MPI workers on a SLURM-managed cluster.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
